linkMethods.title-in-prescribed-or-ncert-context: the NCERT book title appears in the syllabus PDF's 'Prescribed Books' text or next to the word NCERT
linkMethods.subject-textbook-for-class: the prescribed-books text says '<subject> … Textbook for Class <n> … NCERT' and NCERT's index lists that book under the same subject and class
linkMethods.ncert-url-in-syllabus: the syllabus PDF prints the book's ncert.nic.in/textbook.php link
linkMethods.manual-quote: read by hand from the prescribed-books text (quoted)
linkMethods.cbse-statement+ncert-index: CBSE names the NCERT textbook by subject; NCERT's index lists exactly one book for that subject and class
linkMethods.title-in-cbse-subject-name: the CBSE subject name contains the NCERT book title
linkMethods.inferred: CBSE's wording does not name the book; the link is our reading — confirm before relying on it
linkMethods.reference-only: CBSE lists the NCERT book only 'as reference'; the prescribed textbook is CBSE's own

classMethods.ncert-index: XI-XII link: taught in the class NCERT's index files the book under
classMethods.cbse-course-structure: XI-XII link: CBSE's course structure puts the book in another class than NCERT's index (quoted in classEvidence)

bands.note: The 2026-27 curriculum page lists only Secondary (IX, X) and Senior Secondary (XI-XII) documents; there is no CBSE subject scheme for Classes I-VIII on it. Using the NCERT class index for CBSE Classes I-VIII is a working default of this spine, not a CBSE statement.

facts.fact: R3 (third language) is compulsory from Class VI with effect from 2026-27 (Class VII from 2027-28, Class VIII from 2028-29).
Computational Thinking is integrated across subjects in Classes III-V and CT with foundational AI literacy is introduced in Classes VI-VIII from 2026-27, embedded in existing subject periods.
